_provenance: Derived from paraleagle-ext (the H-1B extension) @ origin/main 97efba5 — src/mappings/i129-field-map.ts and src/mappings/i129-subpages.ts. Those two files ARE a live myUSCIS field dump written as TypeScript: the Formik names were read off my.uscis.gov with the extension's Scan All tool on 2026-03-13 and corrected against live drafts through 2026-06-02 (draft 12173958). This file is that dump in the shape the other family-ext captures are vendored in, so test/i129-coverage.test.ts can hold the descriptor and the backend map to it. It is NOT a fresh capture and must not be presented as one.
_options_caveat: `options` come from the H-1B map's radioValues, whose values were matched on the live page by SUBSTRING (paraleagle-ext i129-filler.ts matchesTarget). The family engine matches a radio EXACTLY (value-setter.ts setRadio), so a multi-word option here is label TEXT that worked as a substring, not a value proven to equal the input's `value`. `options_verbatim: false` marks those. Settle them on the live walk — a miss logs every option's value and label.
